extra: Phase 5, the exploit sweep re-run. The gate was met under rules 1.0.0 (each exploit vs T2, 40 games, best exploit 32.5%); the game has changed seven times since, and the field is now the sieger and SM_g2_lane6. Every game puts one of the seven exploit policies against a field member, about 80 games per exploit.

Gate: no exploit's win rate against the field clears 50% with its lower bound. Read section 9d: the vs-anchor columns are the verdict, the overall column is the same thing here since anchors are the only opposition. An exploit near 50% is a strategy the field cannot punish and belongs in front of the lead designer; fogsnipe in particular is the RQ-032/036 question re-asked under reveal radius 2.
Run as four shards on four cloud sessions and merged.
